intro: Nesterov momentum evaluates the gradient at a lookahead position. Work with that supplied gradient and track the actual parameter movement.
task: Return the lookahead point, new velocity, and updated parameters using the velocity-as-displacement convention.
requirements: weights, velocity and lookahead_gradient are matching vectors. momentum and learning_rate lie in [0,1]. The supplied gradient has already been evaluated at weights+momentum*velocity.
Return {"lookahead": w+mu*v, "velocity": mu*v-lr*g, "weights": w+new_velocity}. Do not apply a second lookahead correction to the parameters.

Use finite real numeric values of magnitude at most 1e6, excluding boolean inputs. Each array axis has 1..64 entries and at most 65536 elements total unless a stricter bound is stated. Return NumPy arrays for array outputs, preserve caller inputs, and raise ValueError for invalid inputs.

examples.name: Lookahead correction
examples.output:
{'lookahead': [2.5], 'velocity': [0.2], 'weights': [2.2]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

examples.name: No momentum
examples.output:
{'lookahead': [1.0, 2.0], 'velocity': [-1.0, -0.5], 'weights': [0.0, 1.5]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

examples.name: No previous velocity
examples.output:
{'lookahead': [2.0], 'velocity': [-0.1], 'weights': [1.9]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

hints.title: Follow the data
hints.body: The stored velocity includes the sign and scale of previous movements.

hints.title: Check the boundary
hints.body: The lookahead point is where the supplied gradient was evaluated; it is not the final updated point.

explanation: Momentum carries previous movement forward, while the lookahead gradient corrects the anticipated position. Naming the velocity convention prevents confusion with libraries that store an unscaled gradient buffer.
When momentum is zero the update reduces to SGD. When learning rate is zero, a nonzero previous velocity still moves the parameters under this recurrence.
